tweets.text: The bottleneck in security has shifted from detection to resolution. Teams can surface thousands of vulnerabilities. Acting on them at speed is the hard part. AWS Continuum helps teams focus on the vulnerabilities that are actually exploitable in their environment and take action faster. It validates exposures in sandboxed environments, prioritizes using technical and business context, and can remediate confirmed vulnerabilities across the full stack.
